title: CI Planner input policy
description: Owner-reviewed inputs loaded from the trusted base commit.

mode.description: Shadow runs every job. Enforcement also needs caller opt-in and exact tested merge.

ignored.description: Explicitly unrelated paths; broad ignores can hide new inputs.

inputsComplete.description: Owner assertion, not inferred proof. False always runs the job.

controlNeeds.description: Trusted owner assertion: these needs edges provide ordering/gating only, never runtime data or artifacts. Defaults to no control-only edges.

allowActionPublishers.description: Reviewed publishers whose mutable Action refs may be resolved through GitHub; resolution failure keeps jobs fresh.

actionPins.description: Base-owned expected commit for each allowlisted mutable Action ref; moved or missing pins keep the job fresh.

items.description: Repository-relative literal, * within a segment, or ** as a complete segment. No exclusions.
